description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!</p></div><h3>Your opportunity</h3> <p>New Relic gives engineering teams real-time insight into their software and infrastructure, so they can find and fix problems fast. The Infra Data Pipeline team builds and runs the pipeline that brings infrastructure data into New Relic: metadata, metrics and inventory from our infrastructure agents and cloud integrations. If that pipeline is slow or down, our customers notice.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer 1 on the team, you will own services in production from your first months: you'll build them, deploy them, monitor them and support them. You'll work with Java, Go, Kafka, Kubernetes and AWS alongside engineers in India and Spain, and grow your skills in large-scale observability systems.</p> <h3><br>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Run services in production:</strong>&nbsp;within your first months, deploy, monitor and support the services you own, and join the on-call rotation.</li> <li><strong>Become the owner of a pipeline component:</strong>&nbsp;learn it end-to-end, present its architecture to the team, and be the first responder for its incidents and support requests.</li> <li><strong>Deliver roadmap work end-to-end:</strong>&nbsp;take features from design through deployment and monitoring, and ship them to production every quarter.</li> <li><strong>Keep the pipeline healthy:</strong>&nbsp;create the alerts and dashboards for your services, take part in incident response and retrospectives, and reduce security and technical debt on what you own.</li> <li><strong>Share what you learn:</strong>&nbsp;write runbooks and design notes, and review your teammates' code.</li> </ul> <h3><br>This role requires</h3> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field,&nbsp;<strong>or</strong>&nbsp;equivalent practical software engineering experience.</li> <li>Ability to write, test and debug backend code in Java, Go or another object-oriented language, and willingness to work primarily in Java and Go.</li> <li>Hands-on experience shipping and running code in a real environment, through professional work, internships or substantial projects (for example: deploying it, monitoring it, fixing it when it breaks).</li> <li>Working knowledge of core software engineering practices: version control, automated testing, code review and debugging.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly in English, in writing and in meetings, with a team distributed across time zones.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points if you have</h3> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Experience being on-call for, or monitoring, services you built.</li> <li>Experience with distributed systems or asynchronous messaging (for example Kafka or other message queues).</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes and a cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure).</li> <li>Experience with data ingestion or real-time data pipelines.</li> <li>Experience with Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra or Elasticsearch.</li> <li>Contributions to open source projects.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><em>Leave the appropriate visa sponsorship statement below and remove the other statement:<br><br></em>Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.<br><br>Qualified applicants may inquire about visa sponsorship (including transfer of a current H-1B visa), but the company does not support or sponsor O-1, F-1, or J-1 visas, or candidates who require commencement of an H-1B "cap case" petition for future work authorization. This position is to be filled as soon as possible.<em><br></em></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">[Please insert your recruiter tag and the work arrangement tag for this job below (e.g., #LI-EW1 #LI-Hybrid). Once updated, remove this block of text before saving the job.]</strong></p> <p>#LI-<em data-stringify-type="italic">Insert recruiter tag</em>&nbsp;#LI-<em data-stringify-type="italic">Insert work arrangement tag</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to <a href="mailto:resume@newrelic.com" target="_blank">resume@newrelic.com</a>.</p> <p>We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.</p> <p><strong>Our hiring process</strong><br><br>In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.<br><br>We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the&nbsp;<a href="https://sfgov.org/olse/sites/default/files/FCO%20poster2020.pdf" target="_blank">San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance</a>.<br><br>Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.</p> <p>New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.</p> <p>Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.&nbsp;</p> <p>Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at&nbsp;<a href="https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy" target="_blank">https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy</a></p></div>

About us:
Build the future of banking.

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 
 
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
 
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
 
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
 
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and X.
 

About the Role:
As a Cloud Security & DevSecOps Engineer II, you will play a key role in strengthening the security posture of our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/container platforms and software delivery ecosystem. 
You will work closely with Cloud/Platform, SRE, DevOps, Engineering, Product Security and Risk & Compliance teams to identify and mitigate security risks, build scalable security controls, automate recurring security activities and drive security findings through remediation and closure. 
The role covers Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), IAM & Access Governance, DevSecOps, Kubernetes Security, Infrastructure Security, Vulnerability Management, Security Monitoring, Security Automation and Compliance Engineering, while also contributing to broader Information Security initiatives across the organisation.
 Perform continuous security posture assessments across AWS, Azure and GCP environments and identify cloud misconfigurations, insecure configurations and deviations from security baselines.   Conduct IAM and SSO access reviews , covering users, roles, groups, service accounts/service principals, permissions, access keys and privileged access, and identify excessive or stale access.   Identify and assess publicly exposed cloud resources , insecure network configurations and unnecessary external exposure across compute, storage, databases, load balancers and other cloud services.   Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines , including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, Infrastructure-as-Code scanning, container/image scanning, DAST and software supply-chain controls.   Perform Infrastructure-as-Code security reviews and support secure implementation of Terraform and similar technologies.   Perform Kubernetes and container security assessments , including cluster configurations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload security, image security, hardening and security posture management.   Analyse vulnerabilities and security findings, validate risks and false positives, prioritise remediation and work with Engineering/SRE/DevOps teams to drive findings through closure.   Develop security automation using Python, Bash, cloud APIs and CLIs for IAM reviews, asset inventories, security assessments, compliance checks, monitoring, reporting and evidence collection.   Review cloud network and edge security controls including VPC/VNet, Security Groups/firewalls, load balancers, WAF, TLS/mTLS and public/private connectivity .   Monitor and review CloudSEK alerts and findings , perform initial analysis and validation, and coordinate remediation or escalation with relevant stakeholders.   Support CloudSEK block-rule activities , including review and validation of relevant indicators, domains and URLs, and coordinate appropriate blocking actions with responsible teams.   Support investigation of cloud and security alerts, exposed credentials, suspicious access, provider security notifications and other security events.   Participate in cloud architecture and design security reviews and provide practical security recommendations based on risk, secure-by-design and least-privilege principles.   Support security and audit requirements aligned with frameworks such as CIS, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP .   Develop and maintain security standards, SOPs, hardening guidelines, assessment methodologies, technical documentation and operational runbooks.   Continuously identify opportunities to automate preventive and detective security controls and improve overall Cloud Security and DevSecOps maturity.   Participate in broader Information Security activities including vulnerability management, security assessments, incident investigations, security reviews, audit/compliance. To be successful in this role, you should have:   Strong hands-on understanding of at least one major public cloud platform, preferably AWS , with working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP being an advantage.   Good understanding of cloud security across IAM, compute, storage, networking, encryption, logging and monitoring .   Knowledge of cloud security services such as AWS IAM/IAM Identity Center, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS and EKS , or equivalent services in Azure/GCP.   Hands-on understanding of CI/CD and DevSecOps security , including SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning, IaC scanning and container/image security.   Experience with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent platforms .   Working knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code security .   Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, Kubernetes RBAC, container security and cluster hardening .   Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash or similar languages .   Strong understanding of IAM, least privilege, MFA, privileged access, credential management and access governance .   Understanding of CSPM, KSPM, CWPP and CNAPP concepts.   Knowledge of cloud/network security concepts including VPC/VNet, Security Groups, firewalls, WAF, TLS/mTLS and private/public connectivity .   Experience with security monitoring, alert triage and threat/exposure-management platforms such as CloudSEK or equivalent solutions .   Exposure to security tooling such as Snyk or equivalent SAST/SCA, CSPM, container and infrastructure security solutions .   Understanding of vulnerability management, risk-based remediation and security incident investigation.   Knowledge of security standards and frameworks including CIS Benchmarks, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP .   Ability to independently analyse security findings, document security risks and provide clear and practical remediation recommendations to technical stakeholders.   3–6 years of relevant experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security or related security engineering roles.   Strong hands-on technical experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management and security automation .   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering or a related discipline , or equivalent relevant industry experience.   Relevant cloud/security certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer or equivalent are an added advantage.
